home.amuni_text:
Welcome, o traveler, to the edge of time,
where history breathes in every wind sublime.
Hear the call of ancient stones so stern,
where tales of ladies and old prayers return.

Do not stay your step, dive into this mystery,
Amunì, come, I will show you our history.
home.castellana_intro_text: Speak with the Castellana: your multilingual tour guide to discover hidden stories, unique insights, and culinary pathways through the wonders of the village and its surroundings.

chat.msg2: Are you ready to be guided? Art, golden olive oil, and sweet almonds will delight you.

citizen.intro_text: The beating heart of Amunì lies in those who live in the village every day. Keepers of ancient stories, passed-down flavors, and secrets hidden among the stones and alleys.
citizen.legends_desc: The oldest stories of the village, passed down from generation to generation.
citizen.legend_pizzarrone: The Legend of the Pizzarrone Tower
citizen.audio_title: Listen to prayers and tales in the local dialect
citizen.castle_desc: A millenary fortress: conspiracies, loopholes, secret tunnels, prisons, and epic battles.
citizen.church_desc: A journey through catacombs, traditions, patron saints, and ancient devotions.
citizen.food_desc: Authentic flavors, places to eat, and experiences in the village.

castle.title: The Castle of Caccamo
castle.rhyme_1:
Welcome, o travelers, to the mighty keep,
watching over the valley and history deep.
Perched on the mountain of proud raw stone,
guardian of mysteries and dreams unknown.
castle.rhyme_2:
Within these walls that defy time's decay,
dynasties passed like a wind blown away.
From the bold Chiaramonte to noble names of old,
every chamber speaks of treaties and gold.
castle.rhyme_3:
Look not for dates in a cold, dusty book,
but watch the shadows dancing in a hidden nook.
The Castellana awaits you along the old track,
to bring the secret of Sister Felicia back.
castle.welcomemsg_felicia: Welcome to Caccamo Castle, stranger. I am Sister Felicia. Would you like me to reveal the secrets of the Conspiracy Hall, or do you prefer to hear the old legends of the manor? Just ask.
castle.position: A fortress perched on a rocky spur, with a dominant view over the valley.
castle.defense: Loopholes, thick walls, and patrol pathways tell the story of its defensive function.
castle.conspiracy: Secret rooms and noble chambers were the stage for medieval conspiracies and intrigues.
castle.prisons: The underground prisons still preserve traces of ancient detentions.
castle.legend_brothers: The legend of the two brothers tells of a fatal duel for a lady's love.

castello.title: The Castle of Caccamo
castello.description: The Castle of Caccamo is among the largest and best-preserved Norman fortresses in Sicily. Perched on the living rock since the 11th century, it dominates the San Leonardo valley with its imposing walls, watchtowers, and atmospheric interior halls that evoke centuries of feudal history and chivalric legends.

badia.title: Church of San Benedetto alla Badia
badia.description: A true jewel of Sicilian Baroque, the church is world-famous for its extraordinary floor entirely made of 18th-century majolica, depicting allegorical scenes and naturalistic motifs of rare mastery. A masterpiece of visual art suspended in time.
badia.hours: Tue - Sun: 09:00 – 12:30 | Mon: 14:30 – 18:30 (No regular functions, ideal for visits)
badia.tickets: Full € 2.00 | Reduced € 1.00 (EU Youth 18-25 years or with same-day Castle ticket) | Free under 18

santamaria.title: Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli
santamaria.description: Founded in the 15th century alongside the Dominican convent, the Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli is one of the most important spiritual centers of the village. It houses the remains and relics of Blessed Giovanni Liccio, Patron Saint of Caccamo. Inside, you can admire splendid marble altars and sacred artworks testifying to centuries of deep devotion and pilgrimages.
santamaria.hours: Opening and Visits: Saturday from 16:00 to 17:30 | Sunday from 09:00 to 10:00 and from 11:00 to 12:30. (Holy Masses: Saturday 17:30 | Sunday 10:00).

sangiorgio.title: Church of San Giorgio Martire
sangiorgio.description: The Mother Church of Caccamo, dedicated to St. George the Martyr, is an imposing masterpiece dominating the monumental square below the Castle. Founded in the Norman era and rebuilt in 1614, it preserves an immense artistic heritage: from Gaginiano school sculptures to precious 17th-century canvases by the Flemish painter Matthias Stom, up to rich chapels decorated in mixed marbles.
sangiorgio.hours: Visits Time Slots: Saturday and Sunday 09:30 – 10:45 and 16:00 – 18:00. (Tourist reception is suspended during the Sunday Holy Mass at 11:00).

annunziata.title: SS. Annunziata Parish
annunziata.description: Nestled within the medieval urban fabric, the church stands out for its facade and the atmosphere of deep spirituality within. It preserves finely decorated altars and artistic artifacts that attract visitors and the faithful alike.
annunziata.hours: Mon - Sat: 09:00 – 12:00 | Weekday Masses at 18:00. Sundays and Holidays visits slots: 08:30 - 09:30 and 10:30 - 12:00 (Festive Masses at 09:30, 12:00, 19:00).

cappuccini.title: Convent of the Capuchin Friars
cappuccini.description: A place of silence, meditation, and history, the structures of the Convent are deeply linked to the Franciscan tradition in Sicily. In addition to the conventual structure, the area offers an authentic insight into monastic life and popular devotion.
cappuccini.hours: Accessible mainly upon request or during Franciscan anniversaries. Contact the Tourism Office.
cappuccini.secret_info: 💡 The Hidden Gems of Caccamo: The village is home to no fewer than 33 churches. Use the Din Don Dan map and zoom in on Caccamo to discover real-time opening hours and openings of lesser-known treasures like the Church of San Rocco and other small scattered masterpieces.

chiese_page.poesia_intro:
Five temples of stone, of faith and memory,
open their doors onto a centuries-old history.
chiese_page.verse_angeli:
At the Angeli rests, in the most sacred peace,
Blessed Giovanni, whose village blessings never cease.
chiese_page.verse_badia:
If you descend to the Badia, the ground turns to bloom
in majolica tiles that banish all gloom.
chiese_page.verse_duomo:
Enter the great Duomo, majestic and grand,
where Gagini and Stomer's fine masterpieces stand.
chiese_page.verse_annunziata:
Then the Annunziata reveals painted skies,
and a bell tower guarded from enemy eyes.
chiese_page.verse_cappuccini:
Climb up to Cappuccini on the hill so bright,
between holy altars and a breathtaking sight.
chiese_page.poesia_outro: Let yourself be guided where time has stood still...
